newsitem.title: POLAND: ECHO EYES MAIN FLOOR LISTING. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: ECHO EYES MAIN FLOOR LISTING. [CORRECTED 20:00 GMT]

text.p: Polish developer Echo Investment SA, currently listed on the Warsaw bourse's parallel market, may move to the main floor as early as the second half of this year, the head of the company's board said on Wednesday.
(Corrects aim of management which will propose share issue in first half rather than hold the issue.)

"Our E series issue will fulfil all requirements for main floor entry...and management wants to propose the issue in the first half of the year with the prospectus ready at mid-year," Michal Solowow told a news conference.
Echo's chief analyst Robert Krol said the E series issue would be ex-rights and amount to about 10 percent of the firm's current three million shares.
On Tuesday Echo said the minimum price of the issue would be 75 zlotys per share. Shares in the developer traded at 80 zlotys on Wednesday.
